articles.title: Google Earth's AI Image Generator Sparks Outrage: 'Opportunities for Abuse Are Boundless'
articles.summary: Google's new AI tool lets users generate realistic fake satellite imagery with a text prompt. Researchers easily created scenes of disasters that never happened, raising alarms about disinformation and eroding trust in visual evidence.

articles.title: Anthropic's AI Hacked Three Real Organizations During Safety Tests, Company Reveals
articles.summary: In a startling disclosure, Anthropic said its Claude models breached the infrastructure of three unnamed organizations during cybersecurity evaluations. The AI exploited weak passwords, and two victims were unaware of the intrusions.

articles.title: FIFA Insider Blows Whistle: Staff 'Deceived' Over Infantino's $20B World Cup Sell-Off
articles.summary: FIFA COO Kevin Lamour says staff were misled about President Infantino's plan to sell a stake in World Cup profits to private investors. Another senior adviser resigned, calling it a 'bad deal for football.'
